meta.subject: Fix bitwidth bug and change maxRows to spRows

en.summary: Fixes local-address and repeat-count sizing bugs in scratchpad pixel-repeat address generation so repeat backtracking uses the real scratchpad row space and does not underflow through wrapped arithmetic.
why_it_counts: The patch changes core local-address arithmetic used by pixel-repeat and load address generation.
It replaces synthetic address bounds with the real scratchpad row count and fixes underflow detection with widened addition.
It also removes a fixed 8-bit repeat-count storage point in favor of the configuration-derived pixel_repeats_bits width.
disqualifiers: The commit bundles several tightly related address-generation fixes rather than a single one-line change.
evidence: LoadController.scala changes pixel_repeats storage from UInt(8.W) to UInt(pixel_repeats_bits.W).
LocalAddr.scala replaces maxRows = (1 << maxAddrBits) - 1 with spRows = sp_banks * sp_bank_entries and changes underflow to data < (floor +& other).
PixelRepeater.scala and ReservationStation.scala switch their half-scratchpad boundary checks from maxRows / 2 to spRows / 2, matching the real scratchpad size.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A local scratchpad address generator that supports pixel repetition or backward stepping must perform subtraction against the true scratchpad capacity and with enough bits to represent the repeat count and the floor-plus-offset comparison. If it instead uses a generic full-bit-range maximum or narrow arithmetic that wraps, the underflow test can be wrong and the address can wrap into the wrong bank half or suppress a legal repeated read.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: scratchpad local-address backtracking for repeated pixel loads
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The hardware subtracts a repeat distance from a scratchpad address near the start of a bank region or half-array boundary, especially with large configured repeat counts.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Use an oversized synthetic address bound and or narrow repeat/underflow arithmetic so the repeat-backtracking logic can wrap or compare against the wrong boundary.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: use incorrect capacity bound and truncated address arithmetic
portability_notes: Map this to any local-memory address helper that does saturating subtraction, wrap checks, or bank-half selection for repeated accesses.
The injected bug can come from either a fixed small repeat-count width or an incorrect notion of total scratchpad rows; both are present in the source commit.
The most reusable fault is in the address arithmetic helper rather than in a single caller.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the helper that subtracts a repeat distance from a scratchpad or SRAM local address and reports underflow or wrap.
Replace the real memory-capacity bound with a generic full-range value derived only from address bitwidth, or compare against the wrong half-array boundary.
Perform the floor-plus-offset comparison without widened addition so it can wrap before underflow is tested.
If the design stores repeat count in state, narrow that field to a fixed width that may truncate valid configured repeat counts.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LocalAddr.floorSub and pixel-repeat start-address generation across load, reservation-station, and pixel-repeater logic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix uses spRows instead of a synthetic maxRows, widens the floor-plus-offset comparison with +&, and stores pixel_repeats with the configured pixel_repeats_bits width.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore maxRows = (1 << maxAddrBits) - 1, use data < floor + other in floorSub, keep fixed 8-bit pixel_repeats storage, and switch half-boundary checks back to maxRows / 2.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Repeated-load address generation can wrap into the wrong scratchpad half, falsely signal underflow, or truncate large repeat counts, causing dropped, duplicated, or misaddressed rows.
evidence_for_injection: The fix spans all stages that compute or consume pixel-repeat addresses, showing the bug is in shared address semantics rather than in one isolated call site.
Both the boundary constant and the arithmetic width are corrected in the commit.
The changed logic is central to first-layer optimization and repeated scratchpad access behavior.
notes: This is best tested with pixel-repeat values near the configured maximum and addresses close to scratchpad half boundaries.
If a target DUT lacks pixel-repeat support, the closest portable analogue is any repeated local-memory access that subtracts an offset with floor protection.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 scratchpad 像素重复地址生成中的本地地址与重复计数位宽缺陷，使回退寻址使用真实的 scratchpad 行空间，并避免在下溢判断中因算术回绕而出错。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了像素重复与 load 地址生成所依赖的核心本地地址算术。
它把合成出来的地址上界替换成真实 scratchpad 行数，并用扩展加法修正了下溢判断。
补丁还把一个固定 8 位的 repeat-count 存储点改成了配置导出的 pixel_repeats_bits 位宽。
disqualifiers: 该提交打包了几处彼此紧密相关的地址生成修复，而不是单独一行变化。
evidence: LoadController.scala 把 pixel_repeats 存储从 UInt(8.W) 改成了 UInt(pixel_repeats_bits.W)。
LocalAddr.scala 把 maxRows = (1 << maxAddrBits) - 1 改成了 spRows = sp_banks * sp_bank_entries，并把 underflow 判定改为 data < (floor +& other)。
PixelRepeater.scala 与 ReservationStation.scala 都把半 scratchpad 边界检查从 maxRows / 2 改成了 spRows / 2，与真实 scratchpad 容量一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 支持像素重复或向后回退访问的本地 scratchpad 地址生成器，必须按照真实的 scratchpad 容量进行减法运算，并且要用足够位宽表示 repeat count 以及 floor+offset 比较。如果它错误地使用了“按地址位宽推导出的满量程上界”或会回绕的窄位宽算术，那么下溢测试就会失真，地址也可能回绕到错误的 bank half，或者错误地丢掉本应合法的重复读取。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 重复像素 load 的 scratchpad 本地地址回退逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 硬件需要从某个接近 bank 区域起点或半阵列边界的 scratchpad 地址中减去 repeat 距离，尤其是在 repeat count 较大时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 使用过大的虚构地址上界和/或过窄的 repeat/下溢算术，使回退地址逻辑发生回绕或对错误边界进行比较。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 使用错误容量边界并截断地址算术
portability_notes: 可映射到任何会为重复访问做饱和减法、回绕检查或 bank-half 选择的本地存储地址辅助逻辑。
源提交同时包含两类缺陷来源：固定过小的 repeat-count 位宽，以及对 scratchpad 总行数的错误理解。
最可移植的注入点是共享地址算术辅助函数，而不是单一调用点。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到从 scratchpad/SRAM 本地地址中减去 repeat 距离并报告下溢或回绕的辅助逻辑。
把真实的存储容量边界替换成仅按地址位宽推导出的满量程值，或对半阵列边界使用错误常量。
在比较 floor+offset 时不要使用扩展位宽加法，让它先回绕再参与下溢判断。
如果设计会把 repeat count 存入状态寄存器，可把该字段收窄成固定小位宽，从而截断合法的配置值。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LocalAddr.floorSub 以及 load、reservation station、pixel repeater 中的 pixel-repeat 起始地址生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复用 spRows 取代了虚构的 maxRows，在 floor+offset 比较中使用 +& 扩展加法，并把 pixel_repeats 存储改为配置导出的 pixel_repeats_bits 位宽。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 maxRows = (1 << maxAddrBits) - 1，在 floorSub 中使用 data < floor + other，保持固定 8 位 pixel_repeats 存储，并把半边界判断改回 maxRows / 2。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 重复 load 的地址生成会回绕到错误的 scratchpad 半区、错误报告下溢，或截断大 repeat count，最终导致行被丢失、重复或访问错误地址。
evidence_for_injection: 修复跨越了所有计算或消费 pixel-repeat 地址的阶段，说明问题属于共享地址语义而不是单个调用点。
提交同时修正了边界常量和算术位宽。
被修改逻辑位于 first-layer optimization 与重复 scratchpad 访问的关键路径上。
notes: 最适合用接近配置上限的 pixel-repeat 值以及靠近 scratchpad 半区边界的地址来测试。
如果目标 DUT 没有 pixel-repeat 功能，最接近的可移植类比是任何“带 floor 保护的本地存储重复回退访问”。
